stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist's personal registration was suspended for nine months as a disciplinary sanction. The suspension has ended and she seeks renewal. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: She shall take and pass the MPJE as a prerequisite to renewal.
She shall meet all conditions determined by the Board.
The Board may also require her to take and pass the NAPLEX.
Her suspension falls in the band between six months and two years.
Serving the suspension period is by itself sufficient for renewal.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 4.02(6) applies to a registration revoked or suspended for between six months and two years and requires the applicant to take and pass the MPJE and meet all Board-determined conditions. The additional NAPLEX possibility appears only in 247 CMR 4.02(7), which governs revocation or suspension for more than two years. A nine-month suspension sits in the first band.

choice_analysis.A: Correct: MPJE is required in this band.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: all Board-determined conditions must also be met.
choice_analysis.C: The NAPLEX possibility belongs to the longer band, not to a nine-month suspension.
choice_analysis.D: Correct: nine months falls between six months and two years.
choice_analysis.E: Serving the suspension does not by itself restore the registration.

related_facts: A registration revoked or suspended for more than two years may also require NAPLEX.
explanation.mpje_trap: The two reinstatement bands differ precisely in whether NAPLEX may be added.

reasoning_steps: Place the nine-month suspension in the correct regulatory band
Apply the MPJE and Board-conditions requirements for that band
Withhold the NAPLEX condition reserved for the longer band
